features.title: Supportive high backrest
features.text: Experience enveloping support that cradles your entire back and shoulders. Chubby Sofa’s elevated backrest combines plush comfort with thoughtful ergonomic design, delivering enhanced lumbar support while adapting to your body's natural contours.

features.title: Fluffy and plush comfort
features.text: Sink into generously cushioned seating that feels like settling into a cloud. Chubby's voluptuous proportions and sumptuous foam layers create a nest-like cocoon that encourages complete relaxation. This is seating designed for those who refuse to choose between style and blissful ease.

features.title: Rounded armrests for natural support
features.text: The gracefully curved armrest design of this sofa provides intuitive support for your arms while inviting sideways lounging and relaxed positioning. Gently rounded edges flow seamlessly from the sofa's body, creating a unified silhouette that feels organic rather than angular.

features.title: Contemporary aesthetic with soft curves
features.text: Chubby redefines contemporary design by celebrating curves over sharp lines. Its bold yet balanced proportions make a confident statement piece that commands attention without aggression. Every contour tells a story of intentional design, celebrating tactile pleasure in modern living.

features.title: Generous Ground Clearance
features.text: The sofa sits proudly on refined legs that create practical clearance beneath, simplifying floor maintenance while adding architectural lift to your space.

features.title: Refined upholstery
features.text: The cosy Bouclé fabric brings tactile richness and visual depth to the sofa, while synthetic leather on the sides frames the form with a sleek, tailored edge. This mix of textures delivers a layered, premium look and practical durability suited to everyday family use.
